findings.title: Use datetime-aware cursor conversion for audit logs
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint uses OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by="-datetime", but get_item_key applies math.floor/math.ceil directly to the field value. AuditLogEntry.datetime is a datetime, so building cursors for any nonempty optimized page raises TypeError and returns a server error. value_from_cursor also returns a number instead of converting the timestamp back to a datetime. Reuse DateTimePaginator's conversions (or inherit from it) so both initial requests and subsequent cursor requests work.

findings.title: Django querysets do not support negative slicing
findings.body: When advanced features are enabled and the cursor offset is negative, this branch passes a negative slice start to a Django QuerySet. Django explicitly rejects negative indexing with ValueError rather than handling boundary conditions automatically. Thus the advertised negative-offset feature produces a server error, even with cursor value zero, before any rows are retrieved. Reject invalid offsets with a pagination error or translate them into a supported query instead of slicing with a negative index.

findings.title: Handle organization contexts without a member
findings.body: Organization-authenticated API requests can have organization_context.member=None, such as requests authorized through an organization API token. This new expression unconditionally dereferences that member whenever request.user.is_superuser is false, even when optimized_pagination was not requested. Such requests previously used the normal paginator but now fail with AttributeError. Only evaluate advanced authorization when requested, and explicitly handle contexts without a member.
